evaluation_populations: Same20 inference targets, mean18 excluding teams1/2
selection_use: Descriptive retrospective BG sensitivity only; no method/background selected for an independent test or claimed as universal best.
weighting_note: Every original source output retained; parameter-grid density and aliases mean cross-family unweighted averages are not an overall attack-quality metric.
label_note: These complete families do not train on membership truth; released preliminary truth is used to calculate these retrospective comparisons after frozen predictions.
main_note: All listed scores are preliminary target evaluation, even when the selected public BG source is main. No main membership accuracy is available.
